compositionContract: ProductRuntime exposes a bounded P3 browser-runtime handle with stable active/blocked status and provenance
missing and invalid application-owned bundles fail closed without global Node/browser fallback
only one ephemeral P3 probe may be active at a time and ProductRuntime.close waits for its guaranteed teardown
no P3-002 session/action service is exposed or claimed
behavioral composition tests stage a valid application-owned fake worker bundle and exercise real ProductRuntime initialization/probe/close
